text: Pope Francis told a Mexican TV network he expects his pontificate to be brief, lasting perhaps two to five years, and said he enjoys being pope but would not support an age limit. He praised Pope Benedict XVI for reopening the possibility of popes emeritus. Francis also announced a “Jubilee of Mercy,” beginning in December and ending Nov. 26, 2016.
